$comment: Merge fragment for an EXISTING Kiro custom agent (IDE 1.x / CLI V3). A custom agent needs all three: the Oira server itself (this mcpServers entry, or includeMcpJson: true when the agent already takes servers from mcp.json), the tool selector, and the skill resource. Add them to your agent's own mcpServers, tools and resources; keep its name, prompt, model, permissions, hooks and other servers exactly as they are. Do not replace your agent file with this one.
